title: Clean a tap aerator
safetyNotes: Put a cloth around the aerator so the pliers do not scratch it.
steps: 🚰 Unscrew the aerator at the tap end by hand or with pliers over a cloth.
🧽 Rinse out loose grit in the sink.
🍶 Soak it in vinegar for 30 minutes.
🪥 Brush the mesh with a toothbrush.
✅ Screw it back on and run the tap.

title: Weak toilet flush
safetyNotes: Never mix vinegar with bleach.
steps: 🚽 Lift the seat and look under the rim for clogged holes.
🍶 Pour a cup of vinegar into the overflow tube in the tank. :: The overflow tube is the open pipe inside the tank.
⏳ Wait 30 minutes.
🪥 Scrub the rim holes with a toothbrush.
✅ Flush twice to rinse.

title: Replace a shower hose
safetyNotes: Do not overtighten. Plastic and chrome fittings crack.
steps: 🚿 Unscrew the old hose at both ends, with the wrench over a cloth.
🔍 Check the old rubber washers and replace them.
🔄 Screw the new hose on at the tap end by hand.
🔧 Tighten a quarter turn with the wrench.
💧 Run the water and check for drips.

title: Dripping outdoor tap
safetyNotes: Turn off the water supply to the outdoor tap first.
steps: 💧 Turn off the supply valve inside the house.
🔧 Unscrew the tap cap with the wrench.
⭕ Replace the rubber washer. :: Take the old one to the shop to match the size.
🧵 Wrap thread tape on the threads.
✅ Reassemble and turn the water on slowly.

title: Sink plug does not hold water
safetyNotes: Wear gloves when you clean out hair and dirt.
steps: 🔍 Lift the plug out and look at the rubber seal.
🧽 Clean the plug and the drain edge.
🔧 Unscrew the old plug from its chain with pliers.
⭕ Fit a new plug of the same size.
💧 Fill the sink and check that the water stays.

title: Burnt pan
safetyNotes: Let the pan cool before you touch it.
steps: 🍳 Cover the burnt part with water and a spoon of baking soda.
♨️ Heat it gently for 10 minutes. :: Stay in the kitchen while it heats.
⏳ Turn off the heat and let it cool.
🧽 Scrub with the brush.
✅ Wash with soap and dry.

title: Refresh a wooden chopping board
safetyNotes: Use only food-safe oil. Cooking oil goes rancid.
steps: 🧂 Sprinkle coarse salt over the board.
🍋 Rub it with half a lemon.
⏳ Leave it for 5 minutes, then rinse.
🧽 Dry it completely with a cloth.
🫒 Rub in a little food-safe oil.

title: Dirty tile grout
safetyNotes: Wear gloves. Never mix cleaners.
steps: 🧤 Put on gloves.
🥄 Mix baking soda and water into a paste.
🪥 Spread it on the grout and leave for 15 minutes.
🧽 Scrub with a toothbrush.
💧 Rinse and dry.

title: Streaky windows
safetyNotes: Do not lean out of upper windows. Clean from inside where you can.
steps: 🍶 Fill a spray bottle with half vinegar, half water.
💦 Spray the glass.
⬇️ Pull the squeegee from top to bottom. :: Wipe the blade after every pull.
🧽 Dry the edges with the microfibre cloth.
✨ Polish any streaks.

title: Fresh stain on a carpet
safetyNotes: Test on a hidden corner first.
steps: 🧽 Blot the stain with a clean cloth. :: Never rub, it pushes the stain deeper.
💦 Dab with cold soda water.
🧂 Cover with salt to soak up the stain.
⏳ Wait 15 minutes and vacuum it up.
✅ Blot with cold water and let it dry.

title: Clean a dishwasher
safetyNotes: Unplug the dishwasher before you clean the filter.
steps: 🔌 Unplug it and take out the bottom rack.
🧽 Remove the filter and rinse it under the tap.
🪥 Scrub the filter with a toothbrush.
🍶 Put a cup of vinegar on the bottom and run a hot cycle.
🥄 Sprinkle baking soda and run a short cycle.

title: Clean a microwave
safetyNotes: The bowl will be very hot. Take it out with care.
steps: 🍋 Put lemon slices and water in a bowl.
⏱️ Heat for 3 minutes, then leave the door closed for 5.
🧤 Take the bowl out carefully.
🧽 Wipe the walls with a sponge.
✅ Dry the inside with a cloth.

title: Clean the fridge and its seals
safetyNotes: Unplug the fridge. Put the food in a cool box.
steps: 🔌 Unplug it and put the food in a cool box.
🧺 Take out the shelves and wash them.
🧽 Wipe the inside with baking soda and warm water.
🪥 Clean the rubber seals with a toothbrush.
✅ Dry everything and plug it in.

title: Vacuum cleaner has lost suction
safetyNotes: Unplug the vacuum cleaner first.
steps: 🔌 Unplug it and empty the dust bin.
🧵 Cut hair wrapped around the brush roll with scissors.
🧽 Wash the filter and let it dry for 24 hours. :: A wet filter makes bad smells.
🔍 Check the hose for blockages.
✅ Put it back together and test.

title: Do a home security check
safetyNotes: Never leave a spare key under the door mat or in a flower pot.
steps: 🚪 Check that your door lock turns smoothly and locks fully.
🪟 Check every window lock, including upstairs.
🔦 Walk around outside and look for dark corners.
🔑 Count your keys and note who has a spare.
📝 Write down anything to fix first.

title: Fit a door viewer
safetyNotes: Wear safety glasses.
Check that the door is thick enough for the viewer.
steps: 📏 Measure the door thickness and check it fits the kit. :: Kits state the door thickness they suit.
✏️ Mark the hole at eye level.
🕳️ Drill the hole from the outside with the right drill size.
🔩 Push in the viewer and screw on the inside part.
✅ Check the view from inside.

title: Fit a window lock
safetyNotes: Keep a key where you can reach it fast. Windows are also exits in a fire.
steps: 📏 Choose the spot where frame and window meet.
✏️ Mark the screw holes.
🕳️ Drill small pilot holes.
🔩 Screw on the lock.
🔑 Test it with the window closed, and keep the key nearby.

title: Secure a sliding door
safetyNotes: Make sure you can remove the bar quickly from inside.
steps: 📏 Measure the empty track when the door is closed.
🪚 Cut the rod to that length.
🧽 File the edges smooth.
📎 Stick felt pads on the ends.
✅ Lay the bar in the track.

title: Fill a nail hole
safetyNotes: Wear a dust mask when sanding.
steps: 🧹 Wipe dust from the hole.
🧱 Press filler in with the knife.
⏳ Let it dry.
🧽 Sand it flat.
🎨 Touch up with paint.

title: Scuff marks on a wall
safetyNotes: Test on a small hidden spot first.
steps: 🥄 Mix baking soda with a few drops of water.
🧽 Rub the paste gently on the mark.
🧽 Wipe off with a damp sponge.
✅ Dry with a cloth.

title: Paint a wall
safetyNotes: Open a window. Use a stable step ladder.
steps: 🛋️ Move furniture away and cover the floor with a dust sheet.
🧱 Fill holes and sand them.
📏 Tape the edges of the wall.
🖌️ Paint the edges with a brush first. :: Do the corners before the roller.
🎨 Roll on the first coat and let it dry.
🖌️ Apply a second coat and remove the tape while the paint is slightly wet.

title: Hang a heavy mirror
safetyNotes: Ask someone to help. Heavy mirrors can seriously hurt you.
Check for cables and pipes before drilling.
Do not hang a heavy mirror over a bed.
steps: 🔍 Check the weight limit of the kit and scan the wall.
✏️ Mark two fixing points at the same height.
🕳️ Drill and fit strong wall plugs.
🔩 Fit the hooks and check them with the level.
🪞 Lift the mirror on together with someone.

title: Door slams into the wall
safetyNotes: Hold the door while you work.
steps: 🚪 Open the door and see where the handle hits.
📏 Mark the spot on the wall or floor.
🔩 Screw on a door stop. :: Use stick-on stops on soft walls.
✅ Test the door.

title: Replace old grout
safetyNotes: Wear safety glasses and a dust mask.
Do not use the shower for 48 hours afterwards.
steps: 🔪 Scrape out the cracked grout with the knife.
🧹 Brush out the dust.
🧴 Mix new grout as the pack says.
🧽 Press it into the gaps.
🧽 Wipe off extra with a damp sponge. :: Wipe diagonally so you do not pull grout out.
⏳ Let it set for 48 hours.

title: Loose sofa leg
safetyNotes: Ask someone to lift the sofa. Do not tip it on your own.
steps: 🛋️ Ask someone to tilt the sofa back.
🔍 Check how the leg is fixed.
🔩 Tighten it with the Allen key or by screwing it in.
📎 Stick a felt pad under the leg.
✅ Put the sofa down and test it.

title: Secure tall furniture to the wall
safetyNotes: Check for cables and pipes before drilling.
Tall furniture can fall and cause serious injury.
steps: 🔍 Empty the top of the furniture and scan a safe wall spot.
✏️ Mark the fixing points.
🕳️ Drill the holes and fit the wall plugs.
🔩 Screw the strap to the wall and to the furniture.
✅ Pull gently on the top to test it.

title: Drawer comes off its runners
safetyNotes: Empty the drawer first. Mind your fingers.
steps: 🗄️ Take out the drawer and empty it.
🔍 Look for broken or bent runners.
🪛 Tighten the screws or fix the runner with glue.
🕯️ Rub wax on the rails.
✅ Slide the drawer in and out.

title: Wobbly desk
safetyNotes: Move heavy objects off the desk first.
steps: 🔍 Press each corner to find the short leg.
🔩 Tighten all leg bolts with the Allen key.
📎 Add felt pads under the short leg.
⚖️ Check it with the level.
✅ Put your things back.

title: Hole in a sock
safetyNotes: Keep needles away from children.
steps: 🧦 Turn the sock inside out and spread the hole.
🧵 Sew running stitches around the edge.
🪡 Weave thread across the hole.
🪡 Weave thread the other way.
✂️ Knot and cut.

title: Sleeves too long
safetyNotes: Keep pins and needles away from children.
steps: 📏 Try it on and mark the length with a pin.
📏 Measure the same length on the other sleeve.
✂️ Cut, leaving 3 cm to fold.
📍 Fold twice and pin it.
🪡 Sew small stitches all around.

title: Dirty white sneakers
safetyNotes: Do not put glued shoes in the washing machine.
steps: 👟 Remove laces and insoles.
🥄 Mix baking soda with a little water and soap.
🪥 Scrub the soles and sides with a toothbrush.
🧽 Wipe off the foam with a damp sponge.
⏳ Let them dry away from direct sun.

title: Zip pull is missing
safetyNotes: Keep small parts away from children.
steps: 🔍 Look at what is left of the slider.
🔧 Open the loop of a new pull with pliers.
🔗 Thread it through the slider hole.
🔧 Close the loop firmly.
✅ Test the zip.

title: Hole in the knee of trousers
safetyNotes: Keep needles and scissors away from children.
steps: 👖 Turn the trousers inside out.
✂️ Cut a patch 2 cm bigger than the hole.
📍 Pin it behind the hole.
🪡 Sew all around with small stitches.
✅ Knot, trim and try them on.

title: Dirty, noisy bike chain
safetyNotes: Wear gloves. Degreaser irritates skin.
steps: 🧽 Wipe the chain with a cloth to remove dirt.
🪥 Scrub it with a brush and degreaser.
🧽 Wipe it dry.
🛢️ Drop lube on each link while turning the pedals.
✅ Wipe off the extra.

title: Bike gears jump
safetyNotes: Test ride in a quiet place before you ride on the road.
steps: 🔍 Shift through the gears and note where it jumps.
🔄 Find the cable adjuster near the rear gear. :: It looks like a small barrel on the cable.
🪛 Turn it a quarter turn.
🔄 Test the gears again.
✅ Repeat until it shifts cleanly.

title: Loose bike pedal
safetyNotes: The left pedal turns the opposite way to the right one.
steps: 🔍 Check which pedal is loose.
🧴 Put a little grease on the thread.
🔧 Tighten the right pedal clockwise.
🔧 Tighten the left pedal anticlockwise.
✅ Test by turning the pedals.

title: Squeaky garden gate
safetyNotes: Hold the gate while you work.
steps: 🔍 Find the hinges.
🧽 Wipe off rust and dirt.
🛢️ Spray lubricant on each hinge.
🔩 Tighten loose hinge screws.
✅ Swing the gate a few times.

title: Leaking garden hose
safetyNotes: Turn off the tap first.
Cut away from your hand.
steps: 🚰 Turn off the tap and drain the hose.
🔪 Cut the hose straight at the damaged part.
🔩 Push each end into the connector.
🪛 Tighten the clamps.
💧 Turn the tap on and check for leaks.

title: Repot a plant
safetyNotes: Some plants irritate skin. Wear gloves.
steps: 🗞️ Put newspaper down.
🪴 Loosen the plant gently from the old pot.
🌱 Put compost in the new pot.
🪴 Place the plant at the same depth.
💧 Fill with compost and water it.

title: Prune a small shrub
safetyNotes: Wear gloves and eye protection.
Do not prune in frost or hot sun.
steps: ✂️ Look for dead or damaged branches.
✂️ Cut them back to healthy wood. :: Cut just above a bud.
🌿 Remove branches that cross.
🧹 Collect the cuttings.
💧 Water it afterwards.
